description: Senators act in circular order and ban an opponent. Both parties play optimally. Return the winning party, Radiant or Dire.
intuition: Keep each party’s upcoming turns in a queue. The earlier senator bans the other, then rejoins their queue one round later. Queue head indices avoid shifting arrays.
